prompt: Your study group meets regularly, but sessions drift into general chat. Which structure would make the sessions useful for everyone?

options.text: Each person teaches one topic to the group for ten minutes and answers questions on it
Everyone silently reads the same chapter together for two hours
The strongest student talks for the whole session
Turn every session into a prize quiz and do nothing else

explanation: Preparing to teach a topic forces you to organise and truly understand it, and the group's questions reveal gaps — so the teacher often learns as much as the listeners.
